tagline.en: BMW's 210 hp, 303 km/h superbike for road and track
tagline.hi: BMW's 210 hp, 303 km/h superbike for road and track

summary.en: The S 1000 RR is BMW Motorrad's flagship superbike. Its 999 cc ShiftCam inline-four makes 210 hp, it weighs 198 kg ready to ride, and it reaches 100 km/h in about 3.2 seconds. Track-derived parts like winglets, M brake ducts and Race ABS come from BMW's World Superbike programme.

text.en: Rendered from a third-party 3D model. Labels describe the real current S 1000 RR; the model is not an exact replica.
